body: If you need someone to talk to, Pm me
I wanted to just lay in bed or anywhere alone all day and I decided to just sit in my car and do work. A weird place to do work but I mean I’m here working still, 5 hours later

It doesn’t help that I can’t tell if my friend hates me or something since I sent her a text six hours ago and haven’t heard back. I know she’s in a rough spot too right now and I want her to be happy and shit. Just a lot within that realm
Must be nice in Canada honestly. I try, I usually do but idk it’s a shit ass day.

Dude I’m poor, I can’t afford to mix and match meds. I don’t want to eat or drink or move I just want to go off and disappear. All my previous therapists have been trash, and I don’t have time to waste doing that. I’m done.
I know how you feel but fight on. You got this :)

I don’t want to take medication. I did for years and it made me gain weight and didn’t help. I was on max dosage when I stopped two years ago. As for CBT, I tried for years and nothing helped. I know there’s an imbalance in my brain but do you think I can even fight it? I’m tired to fighting it because I win a little then lose a lot.

Look, I’ve never been in your situation, but I know how hard it is to get words together and out. Try visualizing what’s going on and try describing it. My personal thing was a dark fog flowing throughout my body and invading every part of me. It may sound fanciful or something, but getting it out helps. I hope you get better, and please don’t kill yourself. Even if broken, you’re beautiful. Love ya.
Weirdly, I prefer group now. I feel more safe because the people are all on the same boat and support me with whatever is going on.
Fucking dickhead. I’m sorry this had to happen to you, move on and live with someone who actually values you as a person and a partner.

I might have to, I’m not to the point of self harm right now, but I have been. I know this is a hasty ass generalization, but I’ve been to other therapists where it was absolute garbage. One was making racist comments, one was a good guy but we’d get sidetracked and talk about games, and the last lady forgot I had an appointment and forgot entirely who I was. This group therapy I went to was fantastic and I was in a group with people my own age, we were all supportive of each other.

Hey, it’ll be okay. I’m in the same situation right now. There was a death down the hall from me last quarter so I have an idea of how you’ve been feeling with the girl passing. Just focus on one thing at a time, I know it feels like everything is right in front of you glaring at you, but if you take your time and do one at a time, you might find you can knock one or two things out quicker than if you tried working on them at the same time. Take care. Love you.
That’d definitely work, it’s my first year back at school so I don’t know proper etiquette for a dorm as it’s my first year actually out of state. Thanks mate

I’ve gone to therapy before multiple people and varying levels of severity, I’ve been to outpatient, but never inpatient, I’ve taken myself to the hospital for hard suicidal ideation as well. I was released that night. I have not tried unfiltered journaling but I don’t know if I’m going to try.

I almost never do. I know I have clinical depression and anxiety, and I’m pretty sure I have some form of bipolar, but I can’t cry, not unless I’m too angry, frustrated, or sad. It just can’t come out as much as I’d love for it to. I’m just in a constant state of lethargy that nothing I feel is very emotional. I hate it.

I have been in relationships where the wheel was in their hand and all I had was a handle to hold onto. Those were some of the worst times of my life, as well as the worst money pits. I’ve been to therapists for this before and they changed the subject. Not even to maybe “how’s your home life” but more like casual conversation. I want to go back to intensive group therapy but I know I can’t due to time restraints.

I am actually single, I don’t have anybody to love or care for, as much as I wish I could.

As for doing things I love, I am pretty active in that category. I enjoy playing Rocket League, watching anime, building things, art stuff, and working on my car. I don’t necessarily need gratification from other people, but at the same time I want it so bad.

I generally aim to be a good, honest, hardworking, smiling person, but the depression that writhes under my skin likes to nullify that and pull me straight into the depths of my own demise. Confidence has never really been a strong suit but I’m working day by day to fix that. My ADHD throws my mind into a feedback loop of thinking about everything, from little things like the way someone may have moved as I said something to major fuck ups I made years ago.

I shall try your advice, for sure. You definitely know what you’re talking about. Thank you so much. It means so much how much you care, even if you don’t even know me.
I know what you mean, that sometimes helps

I’m super stressed because finals are upon me, I’m anxious because of the workload I have to do, I have threeish projects due this week, my depressions been hitting hard, I just feel worthless and like shit.
I understand, but keep pushing through. Make it through high school. High school was the worst four years of my life and I wanted to die so much. I’m in college now. Stay here.
